# ClipVault

> ClipVault is a free, open-source Windows clipboard history manager. Press Alt+V to summon a searchable panel of everything you have copied — text, images, files, rich text, links. 100% local: no account, no cloud, no network, no telemetry. Data never leaves the machine.

Site: https://ardss.github.io/clipvault/
Source: https://github.com/ardss/clipvault
Download: https://github.com/ardss/clipvault/releases
License: MIT

## What it does

- Infinite clipboard history (text / images / files / rich text / links), survives reboot
- Instant full-text search (Chinese and English)
- Pin frequently used entries; they are exempt from cleanup
- Paste back into the original window without losing focus
- Categories: all / text / images / links / files / pinned
- Hover preview for long text and full-size images
- Keyboard first: ↑↓ navigate, Enter paste, Del delete, Esc close
- Stats: totals, categories, 7-day trend, top-pasted
- Dark/light theme, Chinese/English UI, optional autostart, configurable hotkey

## Privacy model

- Everything is stored locally in %APPDATA%\com.clipvault.app\ (SQLite + PNG files)
- Password-manager copies are never recorded (ExcludeClipboardContentFromMonitorProcessing / CanIncludeInClipboardHistory markers are honored)
- User-defined sensitive keyword filter; oversized text (>256 KB) is stored as a local side file, never silently dropped
- One-click pause of capture; one-click wipe of the full history
- No network code exists in the binary; the website loads no external resources
